details: Historical finding retracted: exact pre-landing record and lawful post-landing status entry satisfy Act 21/26. No evidence tests were red; CI is not implicated.
evidence_ref: Canonical Git origin/main: records/investigations/town-recovery-integrated-3f7710e-prelanding-c1a00007.json (status verified; exact candidate 3f7710e9fb0ea8ee96a2fe134cbfaefb84cbcdcc, tree 97791e0cab3b954664ccc9dedcc221933963e900; pinned board message sha256:9cXCxSHs-Pxa_eQ20BmRNIX5P2xFSpAX8Z2q5fC1D0Q at 2026-11-10T08:01:30Z; run-all exact commit record includes two runs, first OOM-killed and second exit 0 with 51 passing markers). why_stronger: The original allegation treated the absence of a pre-landing suite-status.json entry as a missing verification gate. Act 21 §§2–3 expressly place the generated suite-status entry in the post-landing records commit for fast-forward landings. The durable pinned pre-landing record now independently inspected identifies the exact candidate commit and tree, records the exact run-all command and two runs (first OOM/no result, second exit 0), with suite output and reviewer claims; the post-landing suite-status entry at a82c3f71 records that exact candidate/tree green. This is stronger and legally controlling evidence than the earlier check limited to suite-status at the candidate.
